title: Nice but not what I hoped for..
text: Nice but not what I hoped for... For the price, nice, not quite what I personally was expecting or hoping for though. I wanted a more rustic, lighter wood color just like the picture. In person it's darker than pictured and more orangish than white wash natural wood like I wanted.

product_metadata.title: Convenience Concepts Laredo Trunk End Table, Natural
description: The Laredo trunk end table brings the right amount of rustic and charm to any space. The Knotty fir wood paired with the decorative metal embellishments make the perfect match. This end table has handles on both sides of it and a latch closure so it can be moved with ease. The hinged top lid allows access to concealed storage you can store anything from DVDs to extra pillows for guests. Look for other items from the Laredo collection by Convenience Concepts sold separately.
